// GREEN fixture for `no-untagged-personal-data` — the AGENT-FABRIC slice (AG-P3 / P-132).
// The lint MUST admit this. Every PII-carrying field of the Agent-Fabric row carries its canonical
// six-tag #[personal_data(...)] classification (architecture agent-fabric §4): the actor identity is
// an opaque pseudonym (erasure = Pseudonymise, contract 4.8), and the per-run conversation/humanised
// card body is encrypted under the per-subject DEK (erasure = CryptoShred, contract 11.4), so the
// crypto-shred erase + the RoPA/data-map fan-out (AG-D10) reach every personal field. The non-PII
// columns (tenant/region partition keys, opaque ids) need no tag. This mirrors the SHIPPED tagged
// schema in myelin-agent-service::schema (held green by the live workspace scan).
pub struct HitlGateRow {
    pub tenant: TenantId,
    pub region: Region,
    pub gate_id: u128,
    #[personal_data(
        category = Identifier,
        role = TenantContent,
        basis = Contract,
        retention = UntilContractEnd,
        erasure = Pseudonymise,
        subject_locator = "agent_principal",
    )]
    pub agent_principal: String,
    #[personal_data(
        category = Content,
        role = TenantContent,
        basis = Contract,
        retention = TenantPolicy,
        erasure = CryptoShred(subject_dek),
        subject_locator = "agent_principal",
    )]
    pub message_body: Vec<u8>,
}
